description: cfd_2d_dambreak_amr4_adapt (four adaptive levels) with the cycle G 48 2 of the composite preconditioner: every level with the residual of its own rows, the solution of the coarser level prolonged into it first, and the half-step exit of BiCGStab (patch 0175, validation CFD AMR speed/02).
covers: cfd_amr::pr_prec with G 48 2 over five grids: the restricted right-hand side, the rows under the finer patches, the flux from the covered cell at the faces of the finer patches
